/-
  Translation of namespacePropsScript.sml
  Proofs about the namespace datatype.
-/
import LeanTypeSound.HOL4Prelude
import LeanTypeSound.Ast
import LeanTypeSound.Namespace

open HOL4

-- ============================================================
-- Definitions
-- ============================================================

/- HOL4:
Definition alist_rel_restr_def:
  (alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 [] ⇔ T) ∧
  (alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 (k1::keys) ⇔
    case ALOOKUP l1 k1 of
    | NONE => F
    | SOME v1 =>
      case ALOOKUP l2 k1 of
      | NONE => F
      | SOME v2 => R k1 v1 v2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys)
End
-/
def alist_rel_restr {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k]
    (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (l1 : List (k × v1)) (l2 : List (k × v2)) :
    List k → Prop
  | [] => True
  | k1 :: keys =>
    match ALOOKUP l1 k1 with
    | none => False
    | some val1 =>
      match ALOOKUP l2 k1 with
      | none => False
      | some val2 => R k1 val1 val2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys

/- HOL4:
Definition alistSub_def:
  alistSub R e1 e2 ⇔ alist_rel_restr R e1 e2 (MAP FST e1)
End
-/
def alistSub {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k]
    (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (e1 : List (k × v1)) (e2 : List (k × v2)) : Prop :=
  alist_rel_restr R e1 e2 (e1.map Prod.fst)

/- HOL4:
Definition nsSub_compute_def:
  nsSub_compute path R (Bind e1V e1M) (Bind e2V e2M) ⇔
    alistSub (λk v1 v2. R (mk_id (REVERSE path) k) v1 v2) e1V e2V ∧
    alistSub (λk v1 v2. nsSub_compute (k::path) R v1 v2) e1M e2M
End
-/
def nsSub_compute {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [BEq n]
    (path : List m) (R : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop) :
    «namespace» m n v1 → «namespace» m n v2 → Prop
  | .Bind e1V e1M, .Bind e2V e2M =>
    alistSub (fun k val1 val2 => R (mk_id path.reverse k) val1 val2) e1V e2V ∧
    alistSub (fun k val1 val2 => nsSub_compute (k :: path) R val1 val2) e1M e2M
  decreasing_by all_goals sorry

-- ============================================================
-- Theorem stubs
-- ============================================================

/- HOL4: Theorem mk_id_thm: !id. mk_id (id_to_mods id) (id_to_n id) = id -/
theorem mk_id_thm {m n : Type} :
    ∀ (id : cml_id m n), mk_id (id_to_mods id) (id_to_n id) = id := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem mk_id_surj: !id. ?p n. id = mk_id p n -/
theorem mk_id_surj {m n : Type} :
    ∀ (id : cml_id m n), ∃ (p : List m) (n_ : n), id = mk_id p n_ := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsSub_mono[mono] -/
theorem nsSub_mono {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n]
    {R1 R2 : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop}
    {e1 : «namespace» m n v1} {e2 : «namespace» m n v2} :
    (∀ (x : cml_id m n) (y : v1) (z : v2), R1 x y z → R2 x y z) →
    (nsSub R1 e1 e2 → nsSub R2 e1 e2) := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAll2_mono[mono] -/
theorem nsAll2_mono {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n]
    {R1 R2 : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop}
    {e1 : «namespace» m n v1} {e2 : «namespace» m n v2} :
    (∀ (x : cml_id m n) (y : v1) (z : v2), R1 x y z → R2 x y z) →
    nsAll2 R1 e1 e2 → nsAll2 R2 e1 e2 := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsLookup_nsEmpty[simp] -/
theorem nsLookup_nsEmpty {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (id : cml_id m n), nsLookup (nsEmpty : «namespace» m n v) id = none := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsLookupMod_nsEmpty[simp] -/
theorem nsLookupMod_nsEmpty {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] :
    ∀ (x : m) (y : List m), nsLookupMod (nsEmpty : «namespace» m n v) (x :: y) = none := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAppend_nsEmpty[simp] -/
theorem nsAppend_nsEmpty {m n v : Type} :
    ∀ (env : «namespace» m n v),
      nsAppend env nsEmpty = env ∧ nsAppend nsEmpty env = env := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem alist_to_ns_nil[simp] -/
theorem alist_to_ns_nil {m n v : Type} :
    (alist_to_ns [] : «namespace» m n v) = nsEmpty := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsSub_nsEmpty[simp] -/
theorem nsSub_nsEmpty {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (r : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop) (env : «namespace» m n v2),
      nsSub r (nsEmpty : «namespace» m n v1) env := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAll_nsEmpty[simp] -/
theorem nsAll_nsEmpty {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (f : cml_id m n → v → Prop), nsAll f nsEmpty := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAll2_nsEmpty[simp] -/
theorem nsAll2_nsEmpty {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (f : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop),
      nsAll2 f (nsEmpty : «namespace» m n v1) (nsEmpty : «namespace» m n v2) := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem alist_to_ns_cons[simp] -/
theorem alist_to_ns_cons {m n v : Type} :
    ∀ (k : n) (val_ : v) (l : List (n × v)),
      (alist_to_ns ((k, val_) :: l) : «namespace» m n v) = nsBind k val_ (alist_to_ns l) := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAppend_nsBind[simp] -/
theorem nsAppend_nsBind {m n v : Type} :
    ∀ (k : n) (val_ : v) (e1 e2 : «namespace» m n v),
      nsAppend (nsBind k val_ e1) e2 = nsBind k val_ (nsAppend e1 e2) := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAppend_assoc[simp] -/
theorem nsAppend_assoc {m n v : Type} :
    ∀ (e1 e2 e3 : «namespace» m n v),
      nsAppend e1 (nsAppend e2 e3) = nsAppend (nsAppend e1 e2) e3 := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsLookup_nsBind[simp] -/
theorem nsLookup_nsBind {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    (∀ (n_ : n) (val_ : v) (e : «namespace» m n v),
      nsLookup (nsBind n_ val_ e) (cml_id.Short n_) = some val_) ∧
    (∀ (id_ : cml_id m n) (n_ : n) (val_ : v) (e : «namespace» m n v),
      id_ ≠ cml_id.Short n_ → nsLookup (nsBind n_ val_ e) id_ = nsLookup e id_) := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAppend_nsSing[simp] -/
theorem nsAppend_nsSing {m n v : Type} :
    ∀ (n_ : n) (x : v) (e : «namespace» m n v),
      nsAppend (nsSing n_ x) e = nsBind n_ x e := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsLookup_nsSing[simp] -/
theorem nsLookup_nsSing {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (n_ : n) (val_ : v) (id_ : cml_id m n),
      nsLookup (nsSing n_ val_ : «namespace» m n v) id_ =
        if id_ == cml_id.Short n_ then some val_ else none := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAll_nsSing[simp] -/
theorem nsAll_nsSing {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (R : cml_id m n → v → Prop) (n_ : n) (val_ : v),
      nsAll R (nsSing n_ val_ : «namespace» m n v) ↔ R (cml_id.Short n_) val_ := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAll2_nsSing[simp] -/
theorem nsAll2_nsSing {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (R : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop) (n1 : n) (v1_ : v1) (n2 : n) (v2_ : v2),
      nsAll2 R (nsSing n1 v1_ : «namespace» m n v1) (nsSing n2 v2_ : «namespace» m n v2) ↔
        n1 = n2 ∧ R (cml_id.Short n1) v1_ v2_ := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsBind_11[simp] -/
theorem nsBind_11 {m n v : Type} :
    ∀ (x : n) (y : v) (ns : «namespace» m n v) (x' : n) (y' : v) (ns' : «namespace» m n v),
      nsBind x y ns = nsBind x' y' ns' ↔ x = x' ∧ y = y' ∧ ns = ns' := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem alist_to_ns_11[simp] -/
theorem alist_to_ns_11 {m n v : Type} :
    ∀ (l1 l2 : List (n × v)),
      (alist_to_ns l1 : «namespace» m n v) = alist_to_ns l2 ↔ l1 = l2 := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsLookup_nsLift -/
theorem nsLookup_nsLift {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (mn : m) (e : «namespace» m n v) (id_ : cml_id m n),
      nsLookup (nsLift mn e) id_ =
        match id_ with
        | cml_id.Long mn' id' => if mn == mn' then nsLookup e id' else none
        | cml_id.Short _ => none := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsLookupMod_nsLift -/
theorem nsLookupMod_nsLift {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] :
    ∀ (mn : m) (e : «namespace» m n v) (path : List m),
      nsLookupMod (nsLift mn e) path =
        match path with
        | [] => some (nsLift mn e)
        | mn' :: path' => if mn == mn' then nsLookupMod e path' else none := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsLookup_nsAppend_some -/
theorem nsLookup_nsAppend_some {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (e1 : «namespace» m n v) (id_ : cml_id m n) (e2 : «namespace» m n v) (val_ : v),
      nsLookup (nsAppend e1 e2) id_ = some val_ ↔
        nsLookup e1 id_ = some val_ ∨
        (nsLookup e1 id_ = none ∧ nsLookup e2 id_ = some val_ ∧
         ∀ (p1 p2 : List m), p1 ≠ [] ∧ id_to_mods id_ = p1 ++ p2 →
           nsLookupMod e1 p1 = none) := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAppend_to_nsBindList -/
theorem nsAppend_to_nsBindList {m n v : Type} :
    ∀ (l : List (n × v)) (e : «namespace» m n v),
      nsAppend (alist_to_ns l) e = nsBindList l e := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsLookupMod_nsAppend_none -/
theorem nsLookupMod_nsAppend_none {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] :
    ∀ (e1 e2 : «namespace» m n v) (path : List m),
      nsLookupMod (nsAppend e1 e2) path = none ↔
        (nsLookupMod e1 path = none ∧
         (nsLookupMod e2 path = none ∨
          ∃ (p1 p2 : List m) (e3 : «namespace» m n v),
            p1 ≠ [] ∧ path = p1 ++ p2 ∧ nsLookupMod e1 p1 = some e3)) := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem eALL_T[simp] -/
theorem eALL_T {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (e : «namespace» m n v), nsAll (fun (_n : cml_id m n) (_x : v) => True) e := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsLookup_nsAll -/
theorem nsLookup_nsAll {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (env : «namespace» m n v) (x : cml_id m n) (P : cml_id m n → v → Prop) (val_ : v),
      nsAll P env ∧ nsLookup env x = some val_ → P x val_ := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAll_nsAppend -/
theorem nsAll_nsAppend {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (f : cml_id m n → v → Prop) (e1 e2 : «namespace» m n v),
      nsAll f e1 ∧ nsAll f e2 → nsAll f (nsAppend e1 e2) := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAll_alist_to_ns -/
theorem nsAll_alist_to_ns {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (R : cml_id m n → v → Prop) (l : List (n × v)),
      (∀ (p : n × v), p ∈ l → R (cml_id.Short p.1) p.2) →
        nsAll R (alist_to_ns l : «namespace» m n v) := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAll_nsLift[simp] -/
theorem nsAll_nsLift {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (R : cml_id m n → v → Prop) (mn : m) (e : «namespace» m n v),

/- HOL4: Theorem nsAll_nsAppend_left -/
theorem nsAll_nsAppend_left {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (P : cml_id m n → v → Prop) (n1 n2 : «namespace» m n v),

/- HOL4: Theorem nsSub_conj -/
theorem nsSub_conj {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (P Q : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop) (e1 : «namespace» m n v1) (e2 : «namespace» m n v2),
      nsSub (fun (id_ : cml_id m n) (x : v1) (y : v2) => P id_ x y ∧ Q id_ x y) e1 e2 ↔

1	/-
2	  Translation of namespaceScript.sml
3	  Defines a datatype for nested namespaces where names can be either
4	  short (e.g. foo) or long (e.g. ModuleA.InnerB.bar).
5	-/
6	import LeanTypeSound.HOL4Prelude
7	
8	open HOL4
9	
10	/- HOL4:
11	Type alist = ``: ('k # 'v) list``
12	-/
13	abbrev alist (k v : Type) := List (k × v)
14	
15	/- HOL4:
16	Datatype:
17	  id = Short 'n | Long 'm id
18	End
19	-/
20	inductive cml_id (m n : Type) where
21	  | Short : n → cml_id m n
22	  | Long : m → cml_id m n → cml_id m n
23	deriving Repr, BEq, Inhabited
24	
25	/- HOL4:
26	Definition mk_id_def:
27	  mk_id [] n = Short n ∧
28	  mk_id (mn::mns) n = Long mn (mk_id mns n)
29	End
30	-/
31	def mk_id {m n : Type} : List m → n → cml_id m n
32	  | [], x => .Short x
33	  | mn :: mns, x => .Long mn (mk_id mns x)
34	
35	/- HOL4:
36	Definition id_to_n_def:
37	 id_to_n (Short n) = n ∧
38	 id_to_n (Long _ id) = id_to_n id
39	End
40	-/
41	def id_to_n {m n : Type} : cml_id m n → n
42	  | .Short x => x
43	  | .Long _ i => id_to_n i
44	
45	/- HOL4:
46	Definition id_to_mods_def:
47	  id_to_mods (Short _) = [] ∧
48	  id_to_mods (Long mn id) = mn::id_to_mods id
49	End
50	-/
51	def id_to_mods {m n : Type} : cml_id m n → List m
52	  | .Short _ => []
53	  | .Long mn i => mn :: id_to_mods i
54	
55	/- HOL4:
56	Datatype:
57	  namespace =
58	    Bind (('n,'v) alist) (('m,namespace) alist)
59	End
60	-/
61	inductive «namespace» (m n v : Type) where
62	  | Bind : List (n × v) → List (m × «namespace» m n v) → «namespace» m n v
63

/-
  Translation of namespaceScript.sml
  Defines a datatype for nested namespaces where names can be either
  short (e.g. foo) or long (e.g. ModuleA.InnerB.bar).
-/
import LeanTypeSound.HOL4Prelude

open HOL4

/- HOL4:
Type alist = ``: ('k # 'v) list``
-/
abbrev alist (k v : Type) := List (k × v)

/- HOL4:
Datatype:
  id = Short 'n | Long 'm id
End
-/
inductive cml_id (m n : Type) where
  | Short : n → cml_id m n
  | Long : m → cml_id m n → cml_id m n
deriving Repr, BEq, Inhabited

/- HOL4:
Definition mk_id_def:
  mk_id [] n = Short n ∧
  mk_id (mn::mns) n = Long mn (mk_id mns n)
End
-/
def mk_id {m n : Type} : List m → n → cml_id m n
  | [], x => .Short x
  | mn :: mns, x => .Long mn (mk_id mns x)

/- HOL4:
Definition id_to_n_def:
 id_to_n (Short n) = n ∧
 id_to_n (Long _ id) = id_to_n id
End
-/
def id_to_n {m n : Type} : cml_id m n → n
  | .Short x => x
  | .Long _ i => id_to_n i

/- HOL4:
Definition id_to_mods_def:
  id_to_mods (Short _) = [] ∧
  id_to_mods (Long mn id) = mn::id_to_mods id
End
-/
def id_to_mods {m n : Type} : cml_id m n → List m
  | .Short _ => []
  | .Long mn i => mn :: id_to_mods i

/- HOL4:
Datatype:
  namespace =
    Bind (('n,'v) alist) (('m,namespace) alist)
End
-/
inductive «namespace» (m n v : Type) where
  | Bind : List (n × v) → List (m × «namespace» m n v) → «namespace» m n v

/- HOL4:
Definition nsLookup_def:
  nsLookup ((Bind v m):('m,'n,'v)namespace) (Short n) =
    ALOOKUP v n ∧
  nsLookup (Bind v m) (Long mn id) =
    case ALOOKUP m mn of
    | NONE => NONE
    | SOME env => nsLookup env id
End
-/
def nsLookup {m n v : Type} [BEq n] [BEq m] :
    «namespace» m n v → cml_id m n → Option v
  | .Bind vals _, .Short x => ALOOKUP vals x
  | .Bind _ mods, .Long mn i =>
    match ALOOKUP mods mn with
    | none => none
    | some env => nsLookup env i

/- HOL4:
Definition nsLookupMod_def:
  nsLookupMod e [] = SOME e ∧
  nsLookupMod (Bind v m) (mn::path) =
  case ALOOKUP m mn of NONE => NONE | SOME env => nsLookupMod env path
End
-/
def nsLookupMod {m n v : Type} [BEq m] :
    «namespace» m n v → List m → Option («namespace» m n v)
  | e, [] => some e
  | .Bind _ mods, mn :: path =>
    match ALOOKUP mods mn with
    | none => none
    | some env => nsLookupMod env path

/- HOL4:
Definition nsEmpty_def:
  nsEmpty = Bind [] []
End
-/
def nsEmpty {m n v : Type} : «namespace» m n v := .Bind [] []

/- HOL4:
Definition nsAppend_def:
  nsAppend (Bind v1 m1) (Bind v2 m2) = Bind (v1 ++ v2) (m1 ++ m2)
End
-/
def nsAppend {m n v : Type} : «namespace» m n v → «namespace» m n v → «namespace» m n v
  | .Bind v1 m1, .Bind v2 m2 => .Bind (v1 ++ v2) (m1 ++ m2)

/- HOL4:
Definition nsLift_def:
  nsLift mn env = Bind [] [(mn,env)]
End
-/
def nsLift {m n v : Type} (mn : m) (env : «namespace» m n v) : «namespace» m n v :=
  .Bind [] [(mn, env)]

/- HOL4:
Definition alist_to_ns_def:
  alist_to_ns a = Bind a []
End
-/
def alist_to_ns {m n v : Type} (a : alist n v) : «namespace» m n v := .Bind a []

/- HOL4:
Definition nsBind_def:
  nsBind k x (Bind v m) = Bind ((k,x)::v) m
End
-/
def nsBind {m n v : Type} (k : n) (x : v) : «namespace» m n v → «namespace» m n v
  | .Bind vals mods => .Bind ((k, x) :: vals) mods

/- HOL4:
Definition nsBindList_def:
  nsBindList l e = FOLDR (λ(x,v) e. nsBind x v e) e l
End
-/
def nsBindList {m n v : Type} (l : List (n × v)) (e : «namespace» m n v) : «namespace» m n v :=
  l.foldr (fun (p : n × v) (e : «namespace» m n v) => nsBind p.1 p.2 e) e

/- HOL4:
Definition nsOptBind_def:
  nsOptBind n x env = case n of NONE => env | SOME n => nsBind n x env
End
-/
def nsOptBind {m n v : Type} (name : Option n) (x : v) (env : «namespace» m n v) :
    «namespace» m n v :=
  match name with
  | none => env
  | some n' => nsBind n' x env

/- HOL4:
Definition nsSing_def:
  nsSing n x = Bind [(n,x)] []
End
-/
def nsSing {m n v : Type} (name : n) (x : v) : «namespace» m n v := .Bind [(name, x)] []

/- HOL4:
Definition nsSub_def:
  nsSub r env1 env2 ⇔ ...
End
-/
def nsSub {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [BEq n]
    (r : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop) (env1 : «namespace» m n v1) (env2 : «namespace» m n v2) :
    Prop :=
  (∀ id_ v1_, nsLookup env1 id_ = some v1_ →
    ∃ v2_, nsLookup env2 id_ = some v2_ ∧ r id_ v1_ v2_) ∧
  (∀ path, (nsLookupMod env2 path = (none : Option («namespace» m n v2))) →
    nsLookupMod env1 path = none)

/- HOL4:
Definition nsAll_def:
  nsAll f env ⇔ ∀id v. nsLookup env id = SOME v ⇒ f id v
End
-/
def nsAll {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [BEq n]
    (f : cml_id m n → v → Prop) (env : «namespace» m n v) : Prop :=
  ∀ id_ val_, nsLookup env id_ = some val_ → f id_ val_

/- HOL4:
Definition nsAll2_def:
  nsAll2 r env1 env2 ⇔
    nsSub r env1 env2 ∧ nsSub (λx y z. r x z y) env2 env1
End
-/
def nsAll2 {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [BEq n]
    (r : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop) (env1 : «namespace» m n v1) (env2 : «namespace» m n v2) :
    Prop :=
  nsSub r env1 env2 ∧ nsSub (fun x y z => r x z y) env2 env1

/- HOL4:
Definition nsDom_def:
  nsDom env = {n | ... nsLookup env n = SOME v}
End
-/
def nsDom {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [BEq n] (env : «namespace» m n v) : Set (cml_id m n) :=
  fun (i : cml_id m n) => ∃ val_ : v, nsLookup env i = some val_

/- HOL4:
Definition nsMap_def:
  nsMap f (Bind v m) =
    Bind (MAP (λ(n,x). (n,f x)) v) (MAP (λ(mn,e). (mn,nsMap f e)) m)
End
-/
def nsMap {m n v w : Type} (f : v → w) : «namespace» m n v → «namespace» m n w
  | .Bind vals mods =>
    .Bind (vals.map fun (name, x) => (name, f x))
          (mods.map fun (mn, e) => (mn, nsMap f e))
  decreasing_by sorry

/- HOL4:
Definition alist_rel_restr_def:
  (alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 [] ⇔ T) ∧
  (alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 (k1::keys) ⇔
    case ALOOKUP l1 k1 of
    | NONE => F
    | SOME v1 =>
      case ALOOKUP l2 k1 of
      | NONE => F
      | SOME v2 => R k1 v1 v2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys)
End
-/
def alist_rel_restr {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k]
    (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (l1 : List (k × v1)) (l2 : List (k × v2)) :
    List k → Prop
  | [] => True
  | k1 :: keys =>
    match ALOOKUP l1 k1 with
    | none => False
    | some val1 =>
      match ALOOKUP l2 k1 with
      | none => False
      | some val2 => R k1 val1 val2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys

/- HOL4:
Definition alistSub_def:
  alistSub R e1 e2 ⇔ alist_rel_restr R e1 e2 (MAP FST e1)
End
-/
def alistSub {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k]
    (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (e1 : List (k × v1)) (e2 : List (k × v2)) : Prop :=
  alist_rel_restr R e1 e2 (e1.map Prod.fst)

/- HOL4:
Definition nsSub_compute_def:
  nsSub_compute path R (Bind e1V e1M) (Bind e2V e2M) ⇔
    alistSub (λk v1 v2. R (mk_id (REVERSE path) k) v1 v2) e1V e2V ∧
    alistSub (λk v1 v2. nsSub_compute (k::path) R v1 v2) e1M e2M
End
-/
def nsSub_compute {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [BEq n]
    (path : List m) (R : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop) :
    «namespace» m n v1 → «namespace» m n v2 → Prop
  | .Bind e1V e1M, .Bind e2V e2M =>
    alistSub (fun k val1 val2 => R (mk_id path.reverse k) val1 val2) e1V e2V ∧
    alistSub (fun k val1 val2 => nsSub_compute (k :: path) R val1 val2) e1M e2M
  decreasing_by all_goals sorry

/- HOL4:
Definition alist_rel_restr_def:
  (alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 [] ⇔ T) ∧
  (alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 (k1::keys) ⇔
    case ALOOKUP l1 k1 of
    | NONE => F
    | SOME v1 =>
      case ALOOKUP l2 k1 of
      | NONE => F
      | SOME v2 => R k1 v1 v2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys)
End
-/
def alist_rel_restr {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k]
    (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (l1 : List (k × v1)) (l2 : List (k × v2)) :
    List k → Prop
  | [] => True
  | k1 :: keys =>
    match ALOOKUP l1 k1 with
    | none => False
    | some val1 =>
      match ALOOKUP l2 k1 with
      | none => False
      | some val2 => R k1 val1 val2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys

/- HOL4:
Definition alistSub_def:
  alistSub R e1 e2 ⇔ alist_rel_restr R e1 e2 (MAP FST e1)

    (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (e1 : List (k × v1)) (e2 : List (k × v2)) : Prop :=
  alist_rel_restr R e1 e2 (e1.map Prod.fst)

    alistSub (λk v1 v2. nsSub_compute (k::path) R v1 v2) e1M e2M
End

def nsSub_compute {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [BEq n]
    (path : List m) (R : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop) :
    «namespace» m n v1 → «namespace» m n v2 → Prop
  | .Bind e1V e1M, .Bind e2V e2M =>
    alistSub (fun k val1 val2 => R (mk_id path.reverse k) val1 val2) e1V e2V ∧
    alistSub (fun k val1 val2 => nsSub_compute (k :: path) R val1 val2) e1M e2M
  decreasing_by all_goals sorry

/-
  Translation of namespacePropsScript.sml
  Proofs about the namespace datatype.
-/
import LeanTypeSound.HOL4Prelude
import LeanTypeSound.Ast
import LeanTypeSound.Namespace

open HOL4

-- ============================================================
-- Definitions
-- ============================================================

/- HOL4:
Definition alist_rel_restr_def:
  (alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 [] ⇔ T) ∧
  (alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 (k1::keys) ⇔
    case ALOOKUP l1 k1 of
    | NONE => F
    | SOME v1 =>
      case ALOOKUP l2 k1 of
      | NONE => F
      | SOME v2 => R k1 v1 v2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys)
End
-/
def alist_rel_restr {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k]
    (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (l1 : List (k × v1)) (l2 : List (k × v2)) :
    List k → Prop
  | [] => True
  | k1 :: keys =>
    match ALOOKUP l1 k1 with
    | none => False
    | some val1 =>
      match ALOOKUP l2 k1 with
      | none => False
      | some val2 => R k1 val1 val2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys

/- HOL4:
Definition alistSub_def:
  alistSub R e1 e2 ⇔ alist_rel_restr R e1 e2 (MAP FST e1)
End
-/
def alistSub {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k]
    (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (e1 : List (k × v1)) (e2 : List (k × v2)) : Prop :=
  alist_rel_restr R e1 e2 (e1.map Prod.fst)

/- HOL4:
Definition nsSub_compute_def:
  nsSub_compute path R (Bind e1V e1M) (Bind e2V e2M) ⇔
    alistSub (λk v1 v2. R (mk_id (REVERSE path) k) v1 v2) e1V e2V ∧
    alistSub (λk v1 v2. nsSub_compute (k::path) R v1 v2) e1M e2M
End
-/
def nsSub_compute {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [BEq n]
    (path : List m) (R : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop) :
    «namespace» m n v1 → «namespace» m n v2 → Prop
  | .Bind e1V e1M, .Bind e2V e2M =>
    alistSub (fun k val1 val2 => R (mk_id path.reverse k) val1 val2) e1V e2V ∧
    alistSub (fun k val1 val2 => nsSub_compute (k :: path) R val1 val2) e1M e2M
  decreasing_by all_goals sorry

/- HOL4: Theorem mk_id_thm: !id. mk_id (id_to_mods id) (id_to_n id) = id -/
theorem mk_id_thm {m n : Type} :
    ∀ (id : cml_id m n), mk_id (id_to_mods id) (id_to_n id) = id := by
  intro id
  induction id with
  | Short x => rfl
  | Long mn i ih => simp [mk_id, id_to_mods, id_to_n, ih]
/- HOL4: Theorem mk_id_surj: !id. ?p n. id = mk_id p n -/
theorem mk_id_surj {m n : Type} :
    ∀ (id : cml_id m n), ∃ (p : List m) (n_ : n), id = mk_id p n_ := by
  intro id
  exact ⟨id_to_mods id, id_to_n id, (mk_id_thm id).symm⟩
/- HOL4: Theorem nsSub_mono[mono] -/
theorem nsSub_mono {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n]
    {R1 R2 : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop}
    {e1 : «namespace» m n v1} {e2 : «namespace» m n v2} :
    (∀ (x : cml_id m n) (y : v1) (z : v2), R1 x y z → R2 x y z) →
    (nsSub R1 e1 e2 → nsSub R2 e1 e2) := by
  intro himp ⟨hv, hm⟩
  refine ⟨?_, hm⟩
  intro id_ v1_ hlook
  obtain ⟨v2_, h1, h2⟩ := hv id_ v1_ hlook
  exact ⟨v2_, h1, himp _ _ _ h2⟩
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAll2_mono[mono] -/
theorem nsAll2_mono {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n]
    {R1 R2 : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop}
    {e1 : «namespace» m n v1} {e2 : «namespace» m n v2} :
    (∀ (x : cml_id m n) (y : v1) (z : v2), R1 x y z → R2 x y z) →
    nsAll2 R1 e1 e2 → nsAll2 R2 e1 e2 := by
  intro himp ⟨h12, h21⟩
  refine ⟨nsSub_mono himp h12, nsSub_mono (fun x y z => himp x z y) h21⟩
/- HOL4: Theorem nsLookup_nsEmpty[simp] -/
theorem nsLookup_nsEmpty {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (id : cml_id m n), nsLookup (nsEmpty : «namespace» m n v) id = none := by
  intro id
  cases id with
  | Short _ => rfl
  | Long _ _ => rfl

theorem nsLookupMod_nsEmpty {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] :
    ∀ (x : m) (y : List m), nsLookupMod (nsEmpty : «namespace» m n v) (x :: y) = none := by
  intros; rfl
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAppend_nsEmpty[simp] -/
theorem nsAppend_nsEmpty {m n v : Type} :
    ∀ (env : «namespace» m n v),
      nsAppend env nsEmpty = env ∧ nsAppend nsEmpty env = env := by
  intro env
  cases env with
  | Bind v m => exact ⟨by simp [nsAppend, nsEmpty], by simp [nsAppend, nsEmpty]⟩

theorem alist_to_ns_nil {m n v : Type} :
    (alist_to_ns [] : «namespace» m n v) = nsEmpty := rfl
/- HOL4: Theorem nsSub_nsEmpty[simp] -/
theorem nsSub_nsEmpty {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (r : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop) (env : «namespace» m n v2),
      nsSub r (nsEmpty : «namespace» m n v1) env := by
  intro r env
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro id_ v1_ h; rw [nsLookup_nsEmpty] at h; cases h
  · intro path

    | nil => intro h; simp at h
    | cons x xs => intro _; rfl
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAll_nsEmpty[simp] -/
theorem nsAll_nsEmpty {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (f : cml_id m n → v → Prop), nsAll f nsEmpty := by
  intro f id_ val_ h; rw [nsLookup_nsEmpty] at h; cases h
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAll2_nsEmpty[simp] -/
theorem nsAll2_nsEmpty {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (f : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop),
      nsAll2 f (nsEmpty : «namespace» m n v1) (nsEmpty : «namespace» m n v2) := by
  intro f
  refine ⟨nsSub_nsEmpty _ _, nsSub_nsEmpty _ _⟩
/- HOL4: Theorem alist_to_ns_cons[simp] -/
theorem alist_to_ns_cons {m n v : Type} :
    ∀ (k : n) (val_ : v) (l : List (n × v)),
      (alist_to_ns ((k, val_) :: l) : «namespace» m n v) = nsBind k val_ (alist_to_ns l) := by
  intros; rfl
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAppend_nsBind[simp] -/
theorem nsAppend_nsBind {m n v : Type} :
    ∀ (k : n) (val_ : v) (e1 e2 : «namespace» m n v),
      nsAppend (nsBind k val_ e1) e2 = nsBind k val_ (nsAppend e1 e2) := by
  intro k val_ e1 e2
  cases e1; cases e2
  rfl
/- HOL4: Theorem nsAppend_assoc[simp] -/
theorem nsAppend_assoc {m n v : Type} :
    ∀ (e1 e2 e3 : «namespace» m n v),
      nsAppend e1 (nsAppend e2 e3) = nsAppend (nsAppend e1 e2) e3 := by
  intro e1 e2 e3

    case ALOOKUP l1 k1 of
    | NONE => F
    | SOME v1 =>
      case ALOOKUP l2 k1 of
      | NONE => F

End
-/
def alist_rel_restr {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k]
    (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (l1 : List (k × v1)) (l2 : List (k × v2)) :
    List k → Prop
  | [] => True
  | k1 :: keys =>
    match ALOOKUP l1 k1 with
    | none => False
    | some val1 =>
      match ALOOKUP l2 k1 with
      | none => False
      | some val2 => R k1 val1 val2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys

/- HOL4:
Definition alist_rel_restr_def:
  (alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 [] ⇔ T) ∧
  (alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 (k1::keys) ⇔
    case ALOOKUP l1 k1 of
    | NONE => F
    | SOME v1 =>
      case ALOOKUP l2 k1 of
      | NONE => F
      | SOME v2 => R k1 v1 v2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys)
End
-/
def alist_rel_restr {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k]
    (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (l1 : List (k × v1)) (l2 : List (k × v2)) :
    List k → Prop
  | [] => True
  | k1 :: keys =>
    match ALOOKUP l1 k1 with
    | none => False
    | some val1 =>
      match ALOOKUP l2 k1 with
      | none => False
      | some val2 => R k1 val1 val2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys

/- HOL4:
Definition alistSub_def:
  alistSub R e1 e2 ⇔ alist_rel_restr R e1 e2 (MAP FST e1)
End
-/
def alistSub {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k]
    (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (e1 : List (k × v1)) (e2 : List (k × v2)) : Prop :=
  alist_rel_restr R e1 e2 (e1.map Prod.fst)

/- HOL4:
Definition nsSub_compute_def:
  nsSub_compute path R (Bind e1V e1M) (Bind e2V e2M) ⇔
    alistSub (λk v1 v2. R (mk_id (REVERSE path) k) v1 v2) e1V e2V ∧
    alistSub (λk v1 v2. nsSub_compute (k::path) R v1 v2) e1M e2M
End
-/
def nsSub_compute {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [BEq n]
    (path : List m) (R : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop) :
    «namespace» m n v1 → «namespace» m n v2 → Prop
  | .Bind e1V e1M, .Bind e2V e2M =>
    alistSub (fun k val1 val2 => R (mk_id path.reverse k) val1 val2) e1V e2V ∧
    alistSub (fun k val1 val2 => nsSub_compute (k :: path) R val1 val2) e1M e2M
  decreasing_by all_goals sorry

nsLookupMod (nsLift mn e) path =
        match path with
        | [] => some (nsLift mn e)
        | mn' :: path' => if mn == mn' then nsLookupMod e path' else none := sorry
/- HOL4: Theorem nsLookup_nsAppend_some -/

    ∀ (e1 : «namespace» m n v) (id_ : cml_id m n) (e2 : «namespace» m n v) (val_ : v),
      nsLookup (nsAppend e1 e2) id_ = some val_ ↔
        nsLookup e1 id_ = some val_ ∨
        (nsLookup e1 id_ = none ∧ nsLookup e2 id_ = some val_ ∧
         ∀ (p1 p2 : List m), p1 ≠ [] ∧ id_to_mods id_ = p1 ++ p2 →
           nsLookupMod e1 p1 = none) := sorry

theorem nsAppend_to_nsBindList {m n v : Type} :

        (nsLookupMod e1 path = none ∧
         (nsLookupMod e2 path = none ∨
          ∃ (p1 p2 : List m) (e3 : «namespace» m n v),
            p1 ≠ [] ∧ path = p1 ++ p2 ∧ nsLookupMod e1 p1 = some e3)) := sorry

  intro e id_ val_ _; trivial

    ∀ (env : «namespace» m n v) (x : cml_id m n) (P : cml_id m n → v → Prop) (val_ : v),
      nsAll P env ∧ nsLookup env x = some val_ → P x val_ := by
  intro env x P val_ ⟨hall, hlook⟩
  exact hall _ _ hlook

theorem nsAll_nsAppend {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :

theorem nsAll_alist_to_ns {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :

theorem nsAll_nsAppend_left {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :

theorem nsSub_conj {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :

  constructor
  · intro ⟨hv, hm⟩

    · intro id_ v1_ hl; obtain ⟨v2_, h1, h2, _⟩ := hv id_ v1_ hl; exact ⟨v2_, h1, h2⟩
